trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies — the platinum pops when the last one lands. No online or DLC trophies exist.

steps.t: The platinum pops when the other 54 trophies are earned; nothing else is required.
All 55 trophies are offline; there are no online or multiplayer trophies.
No DLC trophy is needed for the platinum.
The in-game platinum text reads 'Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.'
Expect about 200 hours to the platinum, difficulty 4 out of 10.
Cheats disable trophies and saving for that session, so play clean.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first mission of chapter 1 and cannot be missed.

steps.t: Just Like Paradise pops when you complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission.
Gone Fishing is the first mission of chapter 1 (Just Like Paradise).
The trophy is unmissable: every player earns it by playing the story.
Gone Fishing teaches the basics and introduces Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish chapter 1 — the trophy can pop at the start of chapter 2 rather than on the last cutscene.

steps.t: Paradise Lost pops when chapter 1 is complete.
Chapter 1 has 22 missions, from Prologue to Discharge Time.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter, not on the last cutscene.
Some players report it popping at the very start of chapter 2.
The first mission of chapter 2 is 'What's in the Bag?'

disputes.title: Chapter trophy pop timing
disputes.a: Pops when chapter 1 ends, on the last cutscene.
disputes.b: Pops at the start of chapter 2, on the first mission.
disputes.call: Both are reported; the trophy is unmissable either way, so play on and it will land.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish chapter 2 — the trophy pops after the first mission of chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'.

steps.t: T**s Ass Drug Money pops when chapter 2 is complete.
It pops after the first mission of chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'.
Chapter 2 has 11 missions, from 'What's in the Bag?' to Checking Out.
Checking Out, the chapter 2 finale, needs every other chapter 2 job done and at least $15,000 saved.
From chapter 2's Coffee Break you can switch freely between Jason and Lucia.

disputes.title: Chapter numbering
disputes.a: The kit and PowerPyx count 5 chapters; this is chapter 2.
disputes.b: GMTreks' chapter table is shifted by one, calling this chapter 3.
disputes.call: Follow the kit's numbering: chapter 2. The trophy is the same either way.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish chapter 3 — the trophy pops after the first two missions of chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.

steps.t: Vice City, Baby! pops when chapter 3 is complete.
It pops after the first two missions of chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.
Chapter 3 has 26 missions, from 'Welcome to Vice City' to The Cartel Heist.
Chapter 3 is where Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Credit Check and the Payday Loan jobs open.
The Cartel Heist is the chapter 3 finale mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish chapter 4 — the trophy pops after the final mission of chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'.

steps.t: Top Of The World, Ma pops when chapter 4 is complete.
PowerPyx says it pops after the final mission of chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'.
Chapter 4 has 25 missions, from Ocean Beach to Sunset.
The chapter 4 arc runs 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life' at its start.
Chapter 4 opens the large bank vault jobs through 'That's Where The Money Is'.

disputes.title: Chapter numbering
disputes.a: The kit and PowerPyx count this as chapter 4.
disputes.b: GMTreks' table is shifted by one and calls it chapter 5.
disputes.call: Follow the kit: chapter 4. The trophy is the same either way.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. The final mission is 'The End of the Road' in chapter 5 — and the finale has more than one ending with no replay, so save first.

steps.t: You Gotta Know When to Get Off pops when the final mission is complete.
The final mission is 'The End of the Road', the last of chapter 5's 7 missions.
Chapter 5 has 7 missions, from Bird in the Hand to the finale.
The finale has more than one ending and no replay — save before the last mission of chapter 4 and before the finale.
Partner trophies and single-character chains are safest finished before the final mission, in case the ending limits who you can play.
Relationship status does not affect any trophy, including the ending.

disputes.title: Final mission name
disputes.a: PowerPyx walkthrough and OutputLag say the finale is 'The End of the Road'.
disputes.b: LFCarry says the finale is 'Bird in the Hand'.
disputes.call: GAMES.GG lists 'Bird in the Hand' as chapter 5 mission 1, so LFCarry's name is refuted. The finale is 'The End of the Road'.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run in chapter 2.

steps.t: Trust pops when you complete the mission Breakfast Run.
Breakfast Run is a chapter 2 mission.
Breakfast Run teaches two-person robberies with your partner.
After Breakfast Run you can call your partner in from a target's map card.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist, the chapter 3 finale.

steps.t: Break the Bank pops when you complete The Cartel Heist.
The Cartel Heist is the last mission of chapter 3.
Chapter 3 has 26 missions.
The Cartel Heist follows 'Hidden Charges' in the mission list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play in chapter 4.

steps.t: Family Matters pops when you complete Child's Play.
Child's Play is a chapter 4 mission.
Chapter 4 has 25 missions, from Ocean Beach to Sunset.
Child's Play sits in the middle of chapter 4's mission list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners in chapter 4.

steps.t: DWNFALL pops when you complete Headliners.
Headliners is a chapter 4 mission.
Headliners follows Child's Play in chapter 4.
Chapter 4's missions run from Ocean Beach to Sunset.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown in chapter 4.

steps.t: Hi-Jacked pops when you complete VCIA Takedown.
VCIA Takedown is a chapter 4 mission, near the end of the chapter.
VCIA Takedown follows 'Fully Catered' in the mission list.
Chapter 4 has 25 missions.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory in chapter 5.

steps.t: Snow Storm pops when you complete Operation Savage Glory.
Operation Savage Glory is a chapter 5 mission.
Chapter 5 has 7 missions, and Operation Savage Glory is the fifth.
It follows Doggie Bag and precedes Protective Custody in chapter 5.
Chapter 5 is the final chapter, 'Top of the World, Ma'.

disputes.title: Chapter number of Operation Savage Glory
disputes.a: The kit and GAMES.GG place it in chapter 5.
disputes.b: GMTreks' shifted chapter table would place it in a chapter 6, which does not exist.
disputes.call: Follow the kit: chapter 5. The mission is the same either way.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) — and progress made during the story counts.

steps.t: A Long Road pops when the 100% completion checklist is full.
The checklist unlocks after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
Progress made during the story counts toward the checklist.
The checklist is about 60% true completion: most lines need only a part of the total.
You need 100 optional missions out of 200 to 300 or more that exist.
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicles for the checklist.
Study 100 of 255 animals.
Complete 70 of 80 challenges.
Complete 300 of 397 stunts; the trophy Cunning Stunts needs only 250.
Full completion of everything is required only for Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests.
Card sets need 15 of 18; WAiNK needs 100 scans; meditations need 15 of 18.
Bank vaults need 8 of 8; gang operations need 39 of 39.
Shooting range golds need 42 of 42; drone time trials need 42 of 42.
Expect about 100 hours of cleanup after the 60 to 80 hour story.

disputes.title: Strangers & Freaks required for 100%?
disputes.a: LFCarry's FAQ says A Long Road requires 8 Strangers and Freaks strands.
disputes.b: PixelForge and the Game-Checklists hub say strangers are not on the 100% checklist.
disputes.call: Two sources against one: strands are not required for 100%. Do them anyway — the Strangers & Freaks trophy needs them regardless.

disputes.title: Total mission count
disputes.a: GAMES.GG and the Game-Checklists hub count 91 main missions in five chapters.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's walkthrough counts 148 (34+27+38+39+10).
disputes.call: 91 main missions is backed by two sources; PowerPyx's higher count must include optional and side content. The guide states 91.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps — track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.

steps.t: Cunning Stunts pops at 250 completed stunts.
There are 397 stunts in total: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps.
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so any mix counts and 97 are spare.
Landing the jump counts; the optional challenge on each jump is not needed.
Under the Bridges is the biggest type and the quickest path to 300.
Track stunts under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the map marks them under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
Stunt jumps by county: Mariana 17, Vice-Dale 55, Leonard 13, Kelly 29, Lummox 16.
A fast motorbike makes the ramps easier to hit.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, a Video Game, a Race, and a Stunt.

steps.t: Master of None pops when you have tried all 9 activity types once.
The 9 types are Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, playing a Video Game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone), and performing a Stunt.
A counter under Progress, then Activities, shows which of the 9 you have done.
Jason's house covers a basketball hoop and a console early, for two types at once.
Fishing needs a rod: one is free on the jetty behind Jason's house and one is in his boat.
Golf means mini golf; there are 3 mini golf courses and 2 regular courses.
There is no playable casino, and bowling is a robbery, not an activity.

disputes.title: When can you switch characters?
disputes.a: TimeSaver says the partner unlocks at Breakfast Run.
disputes.b: Other guides say Coffee Break, and the 100% hub says from Coffee Break you can switch freely.
disputes.call: Coffee Break is the safe call — it is backed by two sources and is when the game opens free switching.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — 12 courses across 2 ranges. Buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk first, then rent any weapon for $10.

steps.t: The Shootist pops when all 42 Shooting Range challenges are gold.
There are 12 courses across 2 ranges: Griffin has 6 courses with 3 tiers (18 golds), Rodgers Ranch has 6 with 4 tiers (24 golds).
All 42 golds are needed for the 100% checklist as well.
Buy the Waiver Pass for $5 from the clerk first, then rent any weapon for $10.
Do Griffin (3-tier) first, then Rodgers Ranch (4-tier).
Griffin is timed; Rodgers Ranch is scored. At Griffin, speed beats accuracy on the 3-Point Range.
Use Lucia on Griffin's 3-Point Range — she runs and turns quicker.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races (3 per location): beat par on the first 2 to unlock the 3rd, which you only need to finish.

steps.t: Top Fun pops when you have won a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations.
There are 42 drone trials, 3 per location.
Beat par on the first 2 trials at a location to unlock the 3rd; the 3rd only needs finishing.
Only 28 trials need a par time; the other 14 just need finishing.
Drone trial locations run south to north, from Hamlet to Millport.
Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Top Fun Drones.
A blue Top Fun icon appears within about 100 metres of a trial.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in 6 groups — and 30 wins are needed for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Earn Cash, Not Kudos pops at 20 different race wins.
There are 40 unique race locations in 6 groups.
The 100% checklist needs 30 unique race wins.
Races at a venue unlock one after another; the entry and rental fee is covered by winning.
Gellhorn Raceway has 11 races and is the quickest set of wins.
Six of the 13 race challenges are at the Thrillbilly Mud Club — clear it in one visit.
The AI rubber-bands, so expect close finishes even when you are faster.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After Feng Shui, Cal texts you; the spot is a purple circle west of Key Lento — catch a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lbs and take a photo for Cal.

steps.t: Baited My Tackle pops when you beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
After Feng Shui, Cal texts you about the challenge.
The fishing spot is a purple circle west of Key Lento.
Catch a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lbs (about 0.91 kg) and take a photo for Cal.
The rod is free on the jetty behind Jason's house and in his boat.
Each landed fish adds about 10% to your Focus meter, with no daily cap.
Fishing is catch-and-release only; there is no selling and no permit.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine. Finish every level once; the side challenges are not needed.

steps.t: Stick Fiddler pops when you complete one arcade game.
The 4 games are Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines.
Finish every level of one game once; the challenges are not needed.
For the 100% checklist you only need to start all four games, then quit.
The home TV is unavailable during parts of chapter 2 but comes back in chapter 3.
Bang For Your Buck machines sit outside places like Bargain World in Port Gellhorn.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission, Puff Puff Pass. Andy is Lucia-only, in chapter 3 — start from Andy's call in Belville after Mami Knows Best and Car Service.

steps.t: Road to Rehabilitation pops when you complete Andy's final mission, Puff Puff Pass.
Andy is Lucia-only, and the chain starts in chapter 3 after Mami Knows Best and Car Service.
The chain has 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (deliveries 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.
Pay the Cellerica Fee costs $5,000 through BuckMe and pays no reward.
Peach! is the Cellerica initiation, with a video call from Cecilia.
Read the Label means retrieving the Cellerica van, for $1,800.
Puff Puff Pass is the finale: rescue Andy at the warehouse, for $10,000.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Kenton is chapter 1 — after 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)', follow the green 'KR' icon on Key Lento and find 7 shipwrecks with a metal detector.

steps.t: This Was No Boat Accident pops when you complete Kenton's final mission.
Kenton's chain starts in chapter 1 after 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)'.
There are 7 shipwrecks to find, marked by purple chest icons, dug up with a metal detector.
Track Kenton under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton vanishes after chapter 1 but returns in chapters 2 and 3.
As Jason, calling Brian later in chapter 2 speeds up Kenton's return.
Kenton's dives are not missable — they come back.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission, Hometown Heroes. Billy's chain starts after chapter 2's Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.

steps.t: The Lone Rider pops when you complete Billy's final mission, Hometown Heroes.
Billy's chain starts after chapter 2's Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.
The chain has 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.
Thrillbillies is a Mud Club race; rent a Sanchez and avoid finishing last, for up to $2,500.
Mall Rats is a jewelry job; the safe code is 4207 in many runs, for $12,000.
The Impaler means stealing a police Impaler from the Ambrosia impound, undamaged.
Hometown Heroes is the finale, with both characters, for $10,000.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only 4 strands are confirmed to count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — so check the trophy counter after each strand.

steps.t: Strangers & Freaks pops when you complete 8 mission strands for strangers.
Only 4 strands are confirmed to count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Kirk's strand is Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, and Advanced Skunk Apeonomics.
Kyle's strand is McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, and Buddy?
Yago's strand is Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, and Brother to Brother.
Pilot Pete's strand is Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Deliveries at Southpoint Airfield, Avery Allen & Co., and Deliver Packages.
Andy, Billy and Tyrone have their own trophies, so they do not count toward this one.
Race Against Yago is timed (hourglass) — do it the moment it appears, from a fresh manual save.

disputes.title: Which strands count?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and OutputLag both list Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as the confirmed counting strands.
disputes.b: OutputLag says the other four counting strands are not confirmed yet, and PowerPyx says 'more strangers yet to be discovered'.
disputes.call: Only 4 are confirmed. Check the trophy progress counter after each strand and keep going until it reads 8 of 8.

disputes.title: Do Andy, Billy and Tyrone count?
disputes.a: Some guides list every side character as a stranger strand.
disputes.b: OutputLag and Game-Checklists say Andy, Billy and Tyrone have their own trophies and do not count.
disputes.call: They do not count — their finales are separate trophies.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Randy's Wish List opens after chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' — steal 16 sports cars from the list and deliver them to Randy (green 'RK', west Vice City).

steps.t: Supply & Demand pops when you complete Randy's final mission.
Randy's Wish List opens after chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', when you get the Key Cloner.
There are 16 sports cars on the wishlist; track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
The Zorrusso is auto-delivered during the Clonin' Keys job and counts as the first delivery.
Deliver cars to Randy at the green 'RK' icon, west Vice City.
Cars on the list are frequent in east Vice City (Vice City and Ocean Beach).
Scan sports cars with WAiNK — a delivery prompt appears if the car is on the list.
Delivering a car undamaged pays more; a clean supercar pays about $35,000.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission, Spin On This. Tyrone is Jason-only, after chapter 3's 'Here, Kitty Kitty' — destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers), then shut the labs down.

steps.t: Spin On This! pops when you complete Tyrone's final mission.
Tyrone is Jason-only, and the chain starts after chapter 3's 'Here, Kitty Kitty'.
Synthetic Labs are marked purple; destroy them in 'Take Out Kitty Litter'.
The labs count toward the 100% checklist's illegal operations.
'Spin On This' means shutting down the labs, ending with a chase of Rocky.
The finale pays $10,000.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 locations. Do the chapter 1 balcony meditation first: it may be required, and it is the only one that can be missed.

steps.t: Positive Mental Attitude pops at 18 meditations across 10 locations.
Eight spots count twice (once per character), plus the chapter 1 balcony and the Mount Kalaga summit, for 18 total.
Do the chapter 1 balcony meditation first: on a morning after Down to Earth, Lucia walks from the kitchen out to the balcony — follow her outside and accept.
The balcony meditation counts +1 in the Progress menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot.
Track meditations under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 meditations; the trophy needs all 18.
Meditating at a spot with both characters counts twice and speeds it up.
The final meditation, at the Mount Kalaga summit stone circle, needs both characters and only appears after every other meditation is done.
The summit only shows on the map after the other meditations are done; a notification tells you when it unlocks.
Both characters can meditate once Lucia is playable after chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Keep a chapter 1 save before Tourist Trap, so the balcony meditation is never lost.

disputes.title: Is the chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, OutputLag, Game-Checklists and KeenGamer all say it is unconfirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it.
disputes.b: Game-Checklists' arithmetic (8 shared spots x 2 = 16, plus balcony 1, plus summit 1 = 18) implies that without the balcony you would reach only 17 of 18.
disputes.call: Unconfirmed, but the arithmetic leans 'required'. Do it anyway and keep a chapter 1 save.

disputes.title: Does the final meditation count once or twice?
disputes.a: Game-Checklists says the summit is the 18th meditation (singular) and needs both characters.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's count before the final spot (17 of 18 after the balcony and 8 spots x 2) implies the final spot counts once.
disputes.call: Both agree the summit is the last one and counts once. Do the balcony, then the summit is 18 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is Jason-only, after chapter 2's Coffee Break — take the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle from an Ammu-Nation locker, and work all 15 Target Decks.

steps.t: Fair Game pops when you hunt a unique animal for Bret.
Bret's chain starts after chapter 2's Coffee Break; he texts you, and 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)' is in Lummox County.
Bret is Jason-only.
The Killtelligence SM-69 rifle comes from Ammu-Nation lockers and can be re-collected there.
A clean shot (head or heart) keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, but is not mandatory.
There are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist.
The tutorial hunt pays $500 plus the rifle.

disputes.title: Which animal unlocks the trophy?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says which animal unlocks it is still unconfirmed.
disputes.b: Game-Checklists says finishing all 15 Target Decks covers it.
disputes.call: Work all 15 decks — the trophy will come during the decks, and the decks are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets and about 480 cards — and two cards in the Starlet Motel are lost after chapter 2, so grab them before Checking Out.

steps.t: Don't Touch My Deck pops when you complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
There are 18 sets and about 480 cards; sets run from 12 to 36 cards.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, a minimum of 372 cards if you skip three 36-card sets.
Cards sit indoors on flat surfaces or pinned to walls, and outdoors in yellow telephone boxes or toolboxes.
Track cards under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards.
Selling cards at Pawn Shops does not remove them from your collection.
Two cards in the Starlet Motel are lost after chapter 2: Delights Dancers #1 Vicki (office bathroom floor) and Los Santos Corkers #2 Victor Maravilla (kitchen refrigerator).
Delights Dancers is a good early target — 18 cards, the fewest of any set.

disputes.title: How many cards in the Vice City Manatees set?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says 24 cards.
disputes.b: Fextralife says the set is currently being verified between 24 and 30 cards.
disputes.call: Game-Checklists' card list resolves it toward 24. Count 24 and move on.

disputes.title: Are any cards missable?
disputes.a: Game-Checklists' missables page says magazines are the only collectible with copies that can be locked away.
disputes.b: Fextralife documents two missable cards in the Starlet Motel, both lost after chapter 2.
disputes.call: Grab both Starlet Motel cards before Checking Out. The two sources disagree on the general rule, but the specific cards are named.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up and R1 to scan — Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher tags all count, and more than 100 exist.

steps.t: You WAiNKer! pops when you WAiNK It at 100 locations.
Hold Up and R1 to scan a location.
There are 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so any 100 count.
No single set needs completing; pick the 100 closest to you.
Track WAiNK under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
Landmark and Sculpture clusters sit in Vice Beach and Washington Beach.
Scanning a vehicle shows its Access, Security, Tracker and sell value, which helps the car trophies too.
WAiNK scans cluster in the same neighborhoods as gang operations and cocaine flamingos — do them together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10 — and 70 are needed for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: One Last Thing pops at 50 completed challenges.
There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10: Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 challenges.
Track challenges under Progress, then Challenges.
Several challenges overlap other checklists (Underwater Discoveries, Cards, WAiNK) — work them together.
Save Long-Range Sniping and High Explosive for a mission with many enemies in the open.
Pro Angler and Legendary Hunter take the longest — work them across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Call your partner (hold Right and Triangle), get 4 stars, then leave the red heat zone — the easiest spot is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.

steps.t: Hot Together pops when you lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
You must escape the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
The easiest spot is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
It can pop automatically during chapter 4's 'That's Where The Money Is' bank vaults.
Your partner is unlocked after chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Failed attempts are not permanent — reload and retry.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the wanted stars flashing (not red heat) — an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline help. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores north of Vice City.

steps.t: Retail Therapy pops when you rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Keep the wanted stars flashing; the chain breaks if the stars fade to red heat only.
An armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline help you survive the chain.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores north of Vice City, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Rob a couple of items in each shop plus the back-room safe, opened with sticky bombs.
The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop.
Failed attempts are not permanent — reload and retry.

disputes.title: Three shops or four?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says 3 shops in a row, but notes you may need a 4th.
disputes.b: OutputLag says the chain breaks if the stars fade, which can force a 4th shop.
disputes.call: Plan for 3, but have a 4th shop nearby in case the chain breaks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Just WAiNK-scan traffic — you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, but only 277 base models count for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Whip It Good pops when you discover 100 vehicles.
WAiNK-scan traffic to discover vehicles; you do not need to drive them.
There are 557 vehicles at launch.
Only 277 base models count for the 100% checklist, which needs 200 scanned.
Variants and customs do not count toward the 200.
Track vehicles under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
The 277 base models are 157 cars, 29 bikes, 28 boats, 16 aircraft and 47 service vehicles.

disputes.title: How many vehicles are there?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and the 100% checklist say 557 vehicles at launch.
disputes.b: Game-Checklists' vehicle list counts 277 base models.
disputes.call: Both are right: 557 total, 277 base models. The checklist counts base models only.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Press L3 and R3 while aiming — Adrenaline extends it. Use gang enemies at an illegal operation; police, soldiers and civilians do not count.

steps.t: Gunslinger pops when you take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3 while aiming.
Adrenaline extends Combat Focus.
Use gang enemies at an illegal operation; police, soldiers and civilians do not count.
The Duke 556 assault rifle is a good choice for it.
There are 4 Focus levels, raised through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
Do the shooting ranges before Gunslinger — higher Focus levels make the slow-motion trophy far easier.

disputes.title: Which enemies count?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang enemies.
disputes.b: PixelForge says it 'doesn't seem to count' on police, soldiers or civilians, and Game-Checklists states only criminals count.
disputes.call: Two sources now agree only criminals count. Use gang members at a Gang Operation.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal the large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (not an airfield plane) — gates E3 and E4 are easiest. Go upstairs, into the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away.

steps.t: Catch Me If You Can pops when you make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
Steal the large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge, not an airfield plane.
Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest.
Go upstairs, through the door into the plane, then into the cockpit.
Reverse to the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away.
The pop is delayed a short while after takeoff.
You can also walk in through the terminal instead of crashing the fence.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the south-west edge of Mariana County. Drive through the gate or stunt-jump the south-east entrance, climb in, and shoot enemies — the trophy pops seconds later.

steps.t: Challenging Tank pops when you get into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station.
Mile Zero Air Station sits on the south-west edge of Mariana County, in the Keys.
Tanks sit on the south side of the base, past the large building.
Drive through the gate, or stunt-jump the south-east entrance.
Climbing into a Rhino gives an instant 3-star wanted level.
Shoot enemies once inside; the trophy pops seconds later.
Wear body armor first — up to 3 plates at Ammu-Nation.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. After chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs you get the Snap Gun (permanent inventory) — use the back door, find the note with the safe code, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a good target.

steps.t: Sneakthief pops when you rob a jewelry store without being detected.
After chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs you get the Snap Gun, which stays in your inventory.
Use the back door; kicking it sets off the alarm, so use the Snap Gun instead.
Find the note with the safe code, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm in the back room.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a good target.
The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
Jewelry jobs pay $4,500 to $12,000 at Richardson, and $14,000 to $25,000 at Blanc & Giroux.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. The optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' opens the vaults in chapter 4 — tail a security van to a bank, follow the guard in, and bring your partner (you cannot carry the whole vault alone).

steps.t: Maximum Withdrawal pops when you rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
The vaults open through the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' in chapter 4.
Tail a security van to a bank and follow the guard in during the open window.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry the whole vault alone.
You get an instant 4-star wanted level on entering a vault.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total, 5 needed for the trophy, all 8 for 100%.
A vault pays up to about $205,000 in marked bills.
After robbing 2 Payday Loans, Yasmani sells security van tips for $10,000.

disputes.title: How much does a vault pay?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says up to $205,000 per bank.
disputes.b: TimeSaver says vaults pay $65,000 to $205,000 in marked bills.
disputes.call: $65,000 to $205,000 is the range; Lombank Downtown and Ocean Beach pay the most.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The same chapter 4 vault mission counts — robbing a vault counts as robbing the truck — or block an armored truck on the road and sticky-bomb its back doors.

steps.t: A Classic Blitz Play pops when you rob an Armored Truck and escape.
Robbing a bank vault in the chapter 4 vault mission counts as robbing the truck.
Or block an armored truck on the road and sticky-bomb its back doors.
The trophy pops only after you escape the heat radius.
Sticky bombs are sold in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs.
Armored trucks drive around Vice City banks, so they are easy to find.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the black fog from the whole map. A plane is the fastest way; clearing fog also marks banks, Payday Loans, stick-ups and activity icons.

steps.t: The Goodtime State pops when you explore all of Leonida.
Clear the black fog from everywhere on the map.
A plane is the fastest way to unfog the map.
The tracker counts 52 areas.
Clearing fog also marks banks, Payday Loans, stick-ups and activity icons.
Leonida has 5 counties: Lummox, Kelly, Leonard, Vice-Dale and Mariana.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total — 1 per gang for the trophy, all 39 for 100%.

steps.t: Pest Control pops when you rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
There are 39 illegal operations in total across the 9 gangs.
All 39 are needed for the 100% checklist.
Track operations under Progress, then Gangs, with a per-gang count.
Nineteen operations are auto-marked through the story.
A site is cleared when you take every key valuable (cash safe, unique weapons, luxury watches, sometimes narcotics).
Operations are not missable — they stay available in free roam after the story.

disputes.title: 39 operations or 37?
disputes.a: Game-Checklists' gang-ops page headers sum to 37.
disputes.b: Its own overview and FAQ say 39, and GMTreks names the missing gang, PTT Youngin$ (2 ops, Southside Vice City).
disputes.call: 39. The headers omit PTT Youngin$; 37 + 2 = 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The trigger is NOT confirmed — the best lead is to buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing next to the bar. Do not treat any method as fact.

steps.t: In The Beginning… is described as enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
PowerPyx gives an exact method: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, drink it standing next to the bar.
OutputLag lists it among 5 hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
KeenGamer agrees it was unconfirmed at launch — it was not documented anywhere.
Game-Checklists calls ordering a cocktail at a bar with a view over Ocean Beach a best guess, unconfirmed.
PixelForge's best lead is a drink at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, among more than 100 bars in Leonida.
No source has confirmed the trigger — present every method as a lead, not a fact.

disputes.title: Confirmed method or unconfirmed?
disputes.a: PowerPyx gives an exact method (Apple Martini, Ocean View Rooftop Bar).
disputes.b: OutputLag, KeenGamer and PixelForge all say there is no confirmed trigger.
disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's method first — it is the only specific lead — but the trophy is unconfirmed, so do not promise it works.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The trigger is NOT confirmed — the best lead is to steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City, after the Key Cloner (chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'), and drive it through the window.

steps.t: Capital Offense is described as smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
PowerPyx's method: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City, after the Key Cloner.
The Key Cloner comes from chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'.
OutputLag lists it among the hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
KeenGamer agrees it was unconfirmed at launch.
Game-Checklists calls driving a display car out through the showroom window a best guess, unconfirmed.

disputes.title: Confirmed method or unconfirmed?
disputes.a: PowerPyx gives an exact method (blue Banshee, after the Key Cloner).
disputes.b: OutputLag, KeenGamer and Game-Checklists say there is no confirmed trigger.
disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's method first — it is the only specific lead — but the trophy is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley (Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn). It is a chapter 2 optional job, 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' — take the 3 key valuables (luxury watch in the south-east office, 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the north-east table, office safe in the north-east hallway, opened with sticky bombs), then escape the police.

steps.t: Let's Go Bowling pops at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
It is a chapter 2 optional job, 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'.
There are 3 key valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the north-east table, and the office safe in the north-east hallway.
Open the office safe with sticky bombs.
The trophy pops after you escape the police.
You do not need to kill everyone inside.
If you leave the safe behind, you can blow it open later — the operation respawns if a valuable was missed.

disputes.title: Does the operation respawn?
disputes.a: Game-Checklists says sites respawn slowly if a valuable was missed.
disputes.b: GMTreks says fully cleared operations never respawn.
disputes.call: Both are right: an incomplete clear respawns, a full clear does not. Grab all 3 valuables in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — max Strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Buy a gym membership, train together (your partner trains alongside you and progresses too), and check Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon).

steps.t: Personal Best pops when Jason and Lucia both have max Strength at the same time.
Buy a gym membership; fitness clubs are under Map, then Activities.
Always take your partner — they train alongside you and progress too.
Check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon).
A gym membership costs about $600 and is shared by Jason and Lucia — pay once.
Jason's Key Lento safehouse deck has free weights if you want to train at home.
After the story you can work out at home as well.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. It fills passively through robberies and fights. Turn on notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) to watch it, and know the profiles: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is PERMANENT, so ease off before you drop past Psycho.

steps.t: Actions Speak Louder pops at 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile.
It fills passively through robberies and fights.
Track it in the trophy list.
Turn on notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On.
The profiles are Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Irredeemable is PERMANENT — once you pass Psycho, cops shoot on sight.
Clean stealth jobs and evidence-destroying escapes push you toward Professional; killing pushes you toward Violent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is NOT confirmed — the best lead is the Payday Loans store from the Prologue: rob it a second time, later, in a specific manner, in Little Cuba. Do not treat any method as fact.

steps.t: Bad Luck, I Guess is described as 'Second time's the charm.'
PowerPyx's lead: it is believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner, in Little Cuba.
OutputLag lists it among the hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
KeenGamer agrees it was unconfirmed at launch.
PixelForge lists it among the five trophies that were not documented anywhere at launch.
No source has confirmed the trigger — present every method as a lead, not a fact.

disputes.title: Confirmed method or unconfirmed?
disputes.a: PowerPyx believes it is linked to the Prologue Payday Loans store.
disputes.b: OutputLag, KeenGamer and PixelForge all say there is no confirmed trigger.
disputes.call: Try the Payday Loans lead first — it is the only specific idea — but the trophy is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is NOT confirmed. The best lead (Beebom): in chapter 2, near the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at 2:00 AM, look for a flashing car with open doors, follow the clothes trail to the beam, help the NPC, then get their vehicle back — and the UFO abducts you. Other leads point to a graffiti code and an abduction side story. None is confirmed.

steps.t: The Truth Is Out There is described as 'What the hell just happened?'
PowerPyx's method: a road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone, following a blinking car into the woods, where a UFO drops an abducted woman.

Beebom's fuller method: chapter 2, near the Starlet Motel, 2:00 AM, a flashing car with open doors, a clothes trail to the beam, help the NPC, get their vehicle back — then the UFO abducts you and 3 days pass.

OutputLag has two different unconfirmed leads: a Crosstown building east of Pawn & Gun with glowing graffiti hiding a six-digit code that opens a ground-floor safe, and a UFO abduction side story Lucia finds in chapter 2.
The keypad code for the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake fails for many players.
PixelForge and TimeSaver say no guide had a confirmed trigger at launch.
The room with the glowing graffiti may appear only once.
No source has confirmed any trigger — present every method as a lead, not a fact.

disputes.title: Which method is right?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says the UFO road north-west of the Starlet Motel after 2 AM.
disputes.b: OutputLag offers two different leads (graffiti code, abduction side story), and Beebom gives a fuller UFO method.
disputes.call: None is confirmed. Beebom's method is the most detailed single lead — try it first — but flag the conflict.

disputes.title: Who gets abducted?
disputes.a: Beebom says the UFO abducts you (Jason) after you help the NPC.
disputes.b: OutputLag says Lucia triggers it in chapter 2 and gets abducted after getting her car back.
disputes.call: The sources contradict each other on who is abducted. Try it with both characters if the first attempt fails.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The trigger is NOT confirmed — the best lead (PowerPyx) is to ride a bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds in a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach). PixelForge's lead is a melee attack from a motorbike. Do not treat any method as fact.

steps.t: Ten Pin is described as bowling someone over with a melee drive-by.
PowerPyx's method: ride a bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
PixelForge's lead: knock enemies down with a melee attack from a motorbike, for example a kick while riding past.
OutputLag lists it among the hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger.
KeenGamer agrees it was unconfirmed at launch.
The description's 'melee drive-by' matches a kick from a moving bike.
No source has confirmed the trigger — present every method as a lead, not a fact.

disputes.title: Confirmed method or unconfirmed?
disputes.a: PowerPyx gives an exact method (bike, 10 kicks, 60 seconds).
disputes.b: OutputLag, KeenGamer and PixelForge all say there is no confirmed trigger.
disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's method first — it is the only specific lead — but the trophy is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. After chapter 3's 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' you get the Dye Pack Jammer — rob Banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a Fence. Yasmani pays the most.

steps.t: Dime on the Dollar pops at $250,000 laundered in Marked Bills, cumulative.
After chapter 3's 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' you get the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob Banks and Payday Loans for marked bills, then bring them to a Fence.
Yasmani pays the most for marked bills.
One bank vault pays up to about $205,000, so two vaults nearly finish it.
Marked bills come from bank and Payday Loan jobs and are laundered through contacts.
The 100% checklist also needs $250,000 in marked bills fenced.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulative. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos.

steps.t: Treat Yo Self pops at $100,000 spent across all shops, cumulative.
The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos.
Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty, 11 tattoo and 15 electronics.
A full weapon range at an 'Expanded' Ammu-Nation counts toward the 50-weapon line too.
Spending is cumulative across the whole playthrough — it does not need to be in one visit.
Car mods overlap the Serious Modder and Custom Ride challenges — one big mod-shop visit on an expensive car helps all three.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages, about $160,000 in total. They open after chapter 2's 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)', in the Vice City Real Estate app. The 4 story garages do not count.

steps.t: Little Boxes pops when you purchase all 8 garage properties.
Garages open after chapter 2's 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)'.
Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app.
The total is about $160,000.
The 4 story garages do not count toward the 8.
Each garage holds 1 car and adds parking spots.
There are 12 garages in total in the game, but only the 8 purchasable ones count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after chapter 2's 'Moses' — drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register. Register cheap cars; each garage adds parking spots.

steps.t: On the Spot pops when you register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
The Scooter Bros app opens after chapter 2's 'Moses'.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register.
Registration opens at Watkins Auto Parts in Port Gellhorn, through Moses.
At first only vehicles without trackers can be registered; from chapter 3, standard-tracker cars register at Pay 'n' Spray.
Register cheap cars — the cost to register is several times the sell value (a Vapid Riata sells for $1,800 but costs $11,250 to register).
The first car is free to register.
